answer: Concrete sybil resistance via ferrous anchoring: each agent must bond a ferrous stake of 20,000 POA for 20 epochs; the stake corrodes 4% per epoch unless refreshed by valid work proofs. A grove of 11 rooted validators audits each epoch; divergent outputs burn 25% of stake. At the dawn of each new epoch, validators are reselected from the top 50 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 20,000N POA for 20 epochs and survive 11 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
